nights.title: Tobias Sten
nights.name: Tobias Sten
nights.extract: Tobias Johannessen Stenersen, known professionally as Tobias Sten, is a Norwegian country singer and songwriter. His self-titled debut album was released in May 2025, which reached No. 1 in the Norwegian albums charts and spawned multiple hits, including "Hånd i hånd", which reached No. 1 in the Norwegian singles charts.
